notes: Issues scan - two new checks: (1) Mechanical system drive - if Windows boots from a spinning hard disk it's flagged as the likely cause of a slow PC, with an SSD-upgrade recommendation. It only flags the actual system drive, so a PC with an SSD boot drive and an HDD for storage is left alone. (2) Low RAM - 4 GB or less is flagged as a warning (page-file thrashing / sluggishness), 5-8 GB as an informational heads-up for heavy multitaskers.
